title: Power Rankings: Nuggets, Hawks rise into top 5
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 12
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Cavs' outlook continues to brighten even though they still don't know if they can pull off a deal for Antawn Jamison or Troy Murphy. Example: Cleveland has fewer road games left (16) than any team in the league.

rankings.summaryHtml: Impressive as it was to see the Blazers pull together to pummel Orlando without Oden, Przybilla and B-Roy, no one wants to see Roy dealing now with the day-to-day uncertainty of a hamstring injury. Enough is enough.
